# Lolixco

> Curated edit discovery and experimental editing feedback under the Golixco brand.

AI assessments may be inaccurate, incomplete or overly generous. Public processing availability depends on the configured service. Uploads and reports are not public discovery content.

## Public pages
- [Home](https://lol.golixco.com/): Discover curated edits across anime, movies, series and gaming. Watch Shorts and explore your own editing choices in Creator Studio.
- [Shorts](https://lol.golixco.com/shorts): Discover short-form edits across your favorite worlds. Watch curated Shorts and open their original YouTube sources.
- [Creator Studio](https://lol.golixco.com/creator-studio): Upload an edit or paste a public YouTube link for six experimental editing assessments, evidence and practical feedback.
- [Explore](https://lol.golixco.com/explore): Explore curated video edits by category, fandom, creator and tag on Lolixco.
- [Immersion](https://lol.golixco.com/immersion): Watch available curated edits in a focused viewing experience with Lolixco Immersion.
- [Help & Support](https://lol.golixco.com/help): Get help with Lolixco discovery, Shorts, Creator Studio, upload limits, experimental scores and processing privacy.
- [Privacy Policy](https://lol.golixco.com/privacy): Learn how Lolixco handles processing choices, uploads, reports, third-party media and experimental AI feedback.
- [Copyright & Rights](https://lol.golixco.com/rights): Understand ownership, embedded third-party content, distribution permissions and rights enquiries on Lolixco.
- [Terms of Use](https://lol.golixco.com/terms): Read the public-beta terms for using Lolixco discovery and experimental edit feedback.
- [Public Beta](https://lol.golixco.com/beta): Learn what Lolixco BETA means, how experimental assessments work and which release limitations remain.

Email support and rights routing are not yet verified. Consult Help and the Rights policy for current contact status.
